generated_by: pipelines/moon_base.py (Claude, Anthropic, under the team's direction); values computed from the PGDA products listed in sources

sources.product: Average solar illumination: fraction of the 18.6-year nutation cycle (hourly steps) with the Sun visible at the surface. The product is a model of LOLA topography, not a direct measurement. File AVGVISIB_75S_120M_201608.TIF (PGDA product 69, south pole 75S-90S).
sources.period: averaged over hourly steps across one 18.6-year lunar nutation cycle; LOLA data 2009-07-13 to 2013-07-18 (GeoTIFF tags START_TIME/STOP_TIME)
sources.credit: Mazarico, E., et al. (2011), Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography, Icarus 211, 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030; NASA GSFC PGDA (product 69 page: https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/69). The page states no licence; cite Mazarico et al. (2011).

sources.product: Permanently shadowed regions: binary map (1 = PSR, 0 = not). Value meaning read from the GeoTIFF offset (raw 20000 -> 1.0); the PDS label could not be read (pds-geosciences.wustl.edu was down). File LPSR_75S_120M_201608.TIF (PGDA product 69, south pole 75S-90S).
